=== bump flake.lock
Entire-Checkpoint: 1bf60ad9778e


=== nvim,tmux: paste from the real clipboard on local sessions
A tmux server first started over SSH keeps SSH_TTY and SSH_CLIENT in its
global environment forever - update-environment refreshes SSH_CONNECTION
but not those two - so every later pane inherits them and a local session
looks remote.

clipboard.lua branched on $SSH_TTY and so took the OSC 52 path, whose
paste handler returned register 0. That register only ever holds the last
yank, so p after dd pasted the wrong text. Drop the branching entirely and
let Neovim autodetect the provider (pbcopy on macOS, wl-copy under Wayland,
xclip under X11, OSC 52 only when there is no local clipboard), and add the
two leaking vars to update-environment - which also stops powerlevel10k
showing an SSH prompt on a local session.
